description: Header file defining the CryptoUtils class with static cryptographic helper functions for QUIC protocol, including key derivation, validation, and cryptographic operations.

classes.name: CryptoUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static cryptographic helper functions for QUIC, including key derivation, validation, and cryptographic operations.

classes.name: CryptoUtils::Diversification
classes.description: A nested class representing key diversification modes used in cryptographic key derivation.

methods.name: CryptoUtils()
methods.description: Deleted constructor to prevent instantiation.

methods.name: Diversification::Never
methods.description: Creates a Diversification instance with mode NEVER.

methods.name: Diversification::Pending
methods.description: Creates a Diversification instance with mode PENDING.

methods.name: Diversification::Now
methods.description: Creates a Diversification instance with mode NOW, using a nonce.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::InitializeCrypterSecrets
methods.description: Derives key, IV, and header protection key from packet protection secret and sets them on a QuicCrypter.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::SetKeyAndIV
methods.description: Derives and sets the key and IV on a QuicCrypter from the packet protection secret.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::GenerateHeaderProtectionKey
methods.description: Generates the header protection key from the packet protection secret.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::GenerateNextKeyPhaseSecret
methods.description: Derives the secret for the next key phase from the current secret.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::CreateInitialObfuscators
methods.description: Creates encrypter and decrypter for initial packet protection based on connection ID.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::ValidateRetryIntegrityTag
methods.description: Validates the retry packet integrity tag.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::GenerateNonce
methods.description: Generates a connection nonce based on current time, orbit, and randomness.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::DeriveKeys
methods.description: Derives encryption keys, IVs, and subkey secrets for QUIC connections.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::ComputeLeafCertHash
methods.description: Computes FNV-1a hash of DER-encoded certificate.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::ValidateServerHello
methods.description: Validates server hello message for correctness and attack prevention.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::ValidateServerHelloVersions
methods.description: Checks server version list for downgrade attacks.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::ValidateClientHello
methods.description: Validates client hello message for correctness and attack prevention.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::ValidateClientHelloVersion
methods.description: Checks client version for downgrade attacks.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::ValidateChosenVersion
methods.description: Verifies that the negotiated version matches the session version.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::ValidateServerVersions
methods.description: Checks for downgrade attacks involving version negotiation.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::HandshakeFailureReasonToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of handshake failure reasons.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::EarlyDataReasonToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of SSL early data reasons.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::HashHandshakeMessage
methods.description: Computes hash of a serialized handshake message.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::GetSSLCapabilities
methods.description: Serializes SSL capabilities.

methods.name: CryptoUtils::GenerateProofPayloadToBeSigned
methods.description: Generates payload for signature inside QUIC Crypto protocol.
